Girls Gone Cycle Monday Ride

Fairview, PA · Road

Women / trans / femmeBeginner friendly

Girls Gone Cycle Monday Ride is a road group ride in Fairview, PA. It rolls every Monday at 6:00 pm from Walnut Creek Middle School parking lot. About 12–30 miles, all levels.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: all levels.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Girls Gone Cycle Monday Ride group ride

Women-only rides west of Erie for everyone from racers to people who just bought a bike. Twelve to thirty miles depending on your level. Helmets mandatory.
